title: Search for a metal tablet given to a boy by aliens
summary: Clas Svahn tells of Search for a metal tablet given to a boy by aliens, about unspecified at Northern Sweden, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
Here in Sweden, we have
been up in the north. Uh there was a guy
who said that he was a a young boy.

plain: A Swedish UFO researcher, Clas Svahn, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a search in the north of Sweden. He says a man there told him that as a young boy he was given a metal tablet by aliens, and Svahn went looking for it. If such a tablet were found, it would be a physical object said to come from non-human visitors.
